exits.label: Mountain Sluice Descent to Oakhaven Harbor

text.title: Map II: The Redmarsh Wastes & Ironheart Cisterns
text.body: Operating from the limestone stilt-stockade of Redmarsh Outpost, rescue the bogged supply convoy, silence the crossfire at Twin Passes, ground the three ruptured Quartz Wardstones, spark the Deep Quarry prisoner revolt, and storm the twin causeways of Ironheart Bastion to confront Gorrathul.
text.obj.0: Main: Relieve the Corduroy Convoy and save the Stilt Granary
text.obj.1: Main: Break the Twin Passes crossfire and slay Zara, the Crimson Prowler
text.obj.2: Main: Ground the 3 Quartz Wardstones and slay Vekor, the Arc Carapace
text.obj.3: Main: Liberate the Deep Quarry ironstone terraces from the Silt Juggernaut
text.obj.4: Main: Storm the twin causeways at the Fork of Spears
text.obj.5: Main: Breach Ironheart Bastion and slay Gorrathul, Warden of the Forked Cisterns
text.obj.6: Side: Follow the skull-markers along Ochre Ditch to recover the boundary survey
text.obj.7: Side: Disarm the Four-Faced Obelisk ambush at the canyon crossroads
text.obj.8: Side: Purify Kaelen's Bog-Curse Cauldron and slay Ssorath, the Venom Patriarch
text.obj.9: Side: Redeem the Third-Dynasty Salt-Vault liens and slay Khepri, the Sunken Embalmer
text.obj.10: Side: Unseal the submerged Third-Dynasty Bronze Sluice in the lower quarry
text.obj.11: Side: Secure iron plating and bitumen pitch for Highgate Watch Stockade
text.msg.1: [QUARTERMASTER'S EYE - Medium: Success] *(Bram measures half a pint of boiled, rusty rainwater into a tin dipper, his thumb guarding the rim as if it were melted gold.)* Read the ration board before you unbuckle your harness, Commander. Half a pint at sunrise, a gill of vinegar-brine at dusk. Pull Wagon-Master Durn's convoy out of the corduroy mud first, then help Zahra ground those humming Quartz Wardstones on the plateau.
text.msg.2: [WAR LOGIC - Easy: Success] *(Wet brush-fires hiss out beneath the limestone stilts as the convoy drivers lash their mules onto dry planks.)* The Corduroy Road is clear and Redmarsh Granary stands intact! Our salt-pork and antivenom reserves are secure.
text.msg.3: [TACTICAL CALCULUS - Challenging: Success] *(Zara's crimson cloak flutters from the central sandstone chimney as the Sand-Clan hornbows fall silent.)* Twin Passes and Highgate Watch are secured! The road onto the central Quartz Plateau lies open.
text.msg.4: [ASTRAL SHIVER - Formidable: Success] *(Copper grounding wire bites into the fractured quartz grooves, bleeding the static storm into the bedrock.)* Vekor's chitinous shell lies cracked and all three Quartz Wardstones are re-attuned! The alkali dust-squalls are subsiding across the basin.
text.msg.5: [COHORT MEMORY - Challenging: Success] *(Three hundred freed miners hammer their pickaxes against the ironstone winch-drums in a deafening cadence.)* Deep Quarry is liberated! Miner Gorin's crews have cut the ore lift feeding Gorrathul's bastion.
text.msg.6: [WAR LOGIC - Formidable: Success] *(Both basalt causeways at the Fork of Spears are cleared of siege giants, and the starved blockhouse garrison cheers from the parapet.)* The twin causeways are ours! Only the steam-sluice gatehouse of Ironheart Bastion remains.
text.msg.7: [VISCERAL DREAD - Heroic: Success] *(Gorrathul crashes onto the salt-crusted stones. As the rusted sluice-wheels turn open, only dry red dust blows through the mountain reservoir arches.)* Gorrathul has fallen—and Engineer Vesper's audit tells the terrible truth: Ironheart's cisterns silted dry years ago. We have the Forked Sluice Key and the Third-Dynasty Hydraulic Charts. The descent to Oakhaven Harbor is open!
text.msg.8: [TACTICAL CALCULUS - Easy: Success] *(Bleached sheep-skulls mark the firm limestone shelf beneath the bog.)* The Ochre Ditch contraband wagons and boundary survey have been recovered!
text.msg.9: [FRONTIER SKEPTICISM - Medium: Success] *(He chips the false directional plaster from the Four-Faced Obelisk, exposing the true Third-Dynasty road carvings.)* The milestone trap is disarmed and the ambush pack is dead.
text.msg.10: [ASTRAL SHIVER - Challenging: Success] *(Slaked lime boils inside the copper cauldron as Ssorath's venomous coils go limp around the oasis wellhead.)* The oasis aquifer is purified and the bog-curse talisman is destroyed!
text.msg.11: [CHILL OF THE VEIL - Formidable: Success] *(Weighed silver tally-tablets strike the bitumen canopic altars, and the copper-wired Hollow Knights lower their blades in unison.)* Khepri the Sunken Embalmer is destroyed and the Third-Dynasty probate debt is discharged!
text.msg.12: [QUARTERMASTER'S EYE - Challenging: Success] *(The submerged bronze sluice-door swings open, revealing crates of unminted Border Mint silver bars hidden by Morvessa's drivers.)* The lower quarry vault is unsealed and the stolen northern bullion is ours!
text.msg.13: [WAR LOGIC - Medium: Success] *(Fresh Deep Quarry iron plates and boiling bitumen seal the salt-rotted oak palisades of Highgate Watch.)* The stockade walls are reinforced against any desert raid!
text.npc.bram: Half a pint of boiled rainwater at sunrise, a gill of vinegar-brine at dusk. Guard the Corduroy Convoy or this outpost dies of thirst before a blade is drawn.
text.npc.tull: Hexer Kaelen and the Venom Patriarch Ssorath have poisoned the central oasis well. Bring me the knuckle-bone talisman from their cauldron and I'll share our purest cistern reserves.
text.npc.zahra: Someone chiseled reverse blood-wards into the twelve primeval Quartz Wardstones. Ground the three main monoliths on the plateau and redeem the Third-Dynasty Salt-Vaults!
text.npc.sabik: Watch the middle sandstone spire at Twin Passes, Commander—Zara's raiders drop crossfire onto both canyon tracks, and the Four-Faced Obelisk has been altered to lure columns into alkali sinkholes.
text.npc.tomas: Gorrathul holds three hundred ironstone miners in chains on the Deep Quarry terraces. Strike the winch-chains and pump the lower gallery to open the submerged bronze sluice!
text.win: The Redmarsh Wastes and Ironheart Cisterns are secured. Armed with the Third-Dynasty Hydraulic Charts, your vanguard descends the coastal switchbacks toward Oakhaven Harbor.
text.fail.1: Your hero has perished beneath the copper sun of the Redmarsh Wastes.
